snippet.title: Rust Runners - The Farm Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Rust Runners, a fast-paced driving and fighting game set in a dismal post-apocalyptic landscape.  To stay alive here, you need more than just speed. You also need strategy, weaponry, and smart vehicle customisation.

 This demo for the prequel shows you a community that is having a hard time and needs aid.  Your job is to keep raiders from stealing their food.  The demo has its own story, collectible mythology, and a look at the world of the complete game.

 Minimum System Requirements

 Windows 10 or later (64-bit)

 Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen R3 processor

 RAM: 3 GB

 Graphics: GeForce GTX 1600 series or anything like it

 DirectX: 10

 Storage: 150 MB of free space

 Important: You need a 64-bit processor and operating system. This video contains gameplay footage of the game mentioned in the title. 
The gameplay is recorded and shared for commentary, review, and educational purposes. 
All rights to the game and its content belong to the respective copyright holders. 
Music and sound effects that may trigger Content ID have been removed or replaced where possible. 
If you are a copyright holder and have concerns, please contact me directly before submitting a claim.
